description: Publish a self-contained HTML document and get back a public URL. Use this whenever the user wants to share, send, or host HTML you produced — a report, dashboard, deck, prototype or one-page site — instead of leaving it as a file they cannot open. The HTML must be self-contained: inline the CSS and JS, or reference them by absolute URL.

html.description: The full, self-contained HTML document to publish. Max 1MB on the free plan, 10MB on Pro, 50MB on Studio/Agency.

password.description: Optional password (4–72 characters). Viewers must enter it to see the page. Paid plans only; omit for a public page.

slug.description: Optional custom path, e.g. 'q3-report' → /p/q3-report. 2–64 lowercase letters, digits and internal hyphens. Requires a paid plan (Pro or above); omit for a random slug.

title.description: Human-readable title. Sets the link-preview title — pass a real one, not a filename.

name: publish_html
title: Publish HTML as a hosted link
